verdict.rationale: Orama's GitHub README lists "Typo Tolerance" (and "Exact Match") as a built-in feature, so the product itself ships fuzzy matching. The evidence is only a bare feature-list mention, with nothing showing default behavior or any configuration. missing for 10: documentation that typo tolerance is on by default, tunable rules for when and how fuzzy matching applies (edit distance, prefix or term-length thresholds, per-field control), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, searches tolerate typos and misspellings out of the box, with tunable rules for when and how fuzzy matching applies
